deals.notes: The 425 (filed by DCA, subject company DCW) is a shareholder letter whose excerpt is cut off before the proposals are listed, so the excerpt does not itself name the merger or the acquirer. DCW's N-8F (2010-12-28) checks 'Merger' as the reason for deregistering and gives board vote June 23, 2010 and shareholder approval September 16, 2010, but names no acquirer, so by the N-8F rule it settles nothing. The DCA-as-acquirer pairing comes only from the 425 header line. Listing status not shown.
